verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a prompt-to-video model (`heygen-video-1`) that generates 5–30 s clips from text or an image, and an `aspect_ratio: "auto"` setting that matches the source footage or image, so a creator can supply a reference image as input. Its other reference-driven features (Photo Avatar from one still, digital twin from a 15 s video) reproduce a person's identity, not a visual style, and the Video Agent's style options are preset picks (cinematic, handmade, retro), not styles derived from a reference. Missing for 10: documented style transfer from a reference image, video-as-style-reference input for new footage, and hands-on corroboration of style fidelity.
